verdict.rationale: The API exposes exemption-certificate objects. Developers can trigger, read and cancel certificate requests, and list or retrieve certificates with per-jurisdiction validity. Certificate management and validation are also listed as product features. Nothing shows a customer or transaction being flagged exempt through the API, or an exemption reason flowing into calculations, reports or filed returns. missing for 10: an API field to mark a customer or transaction exempt, an exemption reason code, evidence that exemptions are applied in /tax/calculations, exemption reasons carried into reporting and filed returns, and independent corroboration.
